_readme: jarvis-kit: generic example allow-list for npm-audit-gate.mjs; the entry below is fictional. Copy to security/npm-audit-allowlist.json and EMPTY the entries array before first use. Every entry needs a reason a reviewer can check and an expiry date; an expired or stale entry fails the gate.

entries.title: Example: catastrophic backtracking in a link pattern
entries.reason: Reached only from the docs build, which renders our own committed files; no user input reaches the parser. The fixed version needs a major upgrade of the docs tool, tracked as REQ-0042.
